title: Record tight mixed peels for the braid endpoint 3214
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Over any field, the plane endpoint `[w]` for `w = sts = tst` with one-line notation 3214 has ordered-pair defect 6. In the adjacent alphabet `s=(1 2)`, `t=(2 3)`, `u=(3 4)`, the last two factors of every shortest paid word are tight peels of the following shape.

- The rightmost factor is `D_s(P)` or `D_t(P)` for an arbitrary rank-one projector `P`. Every `D_u(N)` has defect 7.
- After `D_s(P)`, the next factor is `D_s(I-P)`, or `D_t(N)` for an arbitrary rank-one projector `N`.
- After `D_t(P)`, the next factor is `D_t(I-P)`, or `D_s(N)` for an arbitrary rank-one projector `N`.
- The forced continuation leaves a pure permutation of defect 4. Every free continuation also has defect 4, and every `u`-continuation has defect 6.

Doubled reduced words attain defect 6, so both right descents occur in a minimum word. The argument is the pair table for the repeated label, and a diagonal reduction of the free label whose pivots lie in the multiplicative group generated by `μ` and `μ-1`. The all-field quantifier is that written argument. The F2, F3 and F5 census compares two defect engines and does not replace it.

This is a scoped peel table. It is not a shortest-word census, a caller invoice, or a change to the selected conditional value `781451/250000000`. Spectator elimination is assumed from the inherited lemma and is not replayed. A tight free second peel may still fail to extend to six factors.

## Task and overlap

Base commit `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a` on canonical CrocSwap main. Suggested head `878ca41524c8a29423a443167f53e519fea61eaf` from fork branch `cursor/braid-endpoint-mixed-peel-b270`.

Eligible handoff item: Discussion #1166 comment 19367347, the first alternative, one braid endpoint's mixed peel constraints. Task card `formal-interface-lemma`, scope changed: the card asks for a caller-bound interface lemma, and this package answers the released peel question instead.

PR #6550 classifies the different endpoint `st` and releases this question. PR #6449 is the ordered-pair predecessor. PR #3147 is an older centre-sink braid sparsity note. Comments on #1166 after 19367347 through 2026-11-03T13:04:01Z do not take this peel. No matches is not proof that a hidden diff is absent.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/braid-endpoint-mixed-peel
```

Result: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/braid-endpoint-mixed-peel outcome=completed` and `PASS_BRAID_ENDPOINT_MIXED_PEEL checks=1436`.

`scripts/check_research_commit.py` reports `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` for `878ca41524c8a29423a443167f53e519fea61eaf`. No selected full replay, Lean build, or Docker run.

Failure controls include the non-idempotent matrix `[[0,0],[1,-1]]` (defect stays 5), the wrong repeated projector (defect 6), the `st` s-row (it does not transfer), and the empty open orbit over F2.

## Credit

Spectator elimination: Brian/JoyboyBrian PR #4765, used and not replayed. Ordered-pair defect and rank-one rigidity: Nick Petalas PR #6449. Inversion tariff: Ross Richardson PR #1989 and Adam Gall's cut lineage. The released question and the `st` classification: ToikY PR #6550.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. New work is Apache-2.0. This is an author-checked argument and an exact replay of its rank certificate, not an independent human review or a kernel check.

## Open next questions

Recorded in `research/braid-endpoint-mixed-peel/TASK.json` and the package README.

- Which shortest normalized words realize `w=3214`? The free second peel may be any rank-one projector, so the `st` count `m^2+m` does not transfer. Next step: one discriminating exact join, over one small field, of the length-6 words allowed by this table. Blocker: the remainder after two peels is a new mixed operator, and a tight free peel may fail to extend.
- What is the complete physical cost of one noncommuting realization? Next step: fix one caller, the literal scalar maps, the owned lifetimes and the consumer, then compare invoices. Blocker: no tape, precision, stock, compiler, or caller tariff is supplied here.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The handoff's first alternative was specific enough to start from the released question without redrawing the catalogue card. The package metadata then required an explicit scope change, which matches the distance between that card and the peel.
